name: Braulio Kariuki-Chatterjee-Somchai
role: street-level organ harvester and black-market tissue broker
location: The Undertow, operating out of a submerged-level cold storage unit beneath the Menomonee Gulch flood barriers, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Braulio Kariuki-Chatterjee-Somchai is lean in the way people get when they've been hungry enough times that the body learns to run efficient. His Tswana-Botswanan heritage shows in his cheekbones and dark complexion; his Croatian-Mexican grandmother gave him an incongruous surname and a slight curl to his black hair, worn short and without product. He has bioluminescent striping across his collarbones — a cheap modification he got at sixteen from a back-alley geneware parlor, blue-white lines that glow faintly through the neckline of his shirts. He keeps his hands very clean. This is the thing people notice: immaculate nails, no blood under them, even when he's come directly from work.

Braulio Kariuki-Chatterjee-Somchai did not choose this profession romantically or willingly. He slid into it at nineteen when a hospital orderly job at the Aurochs Medical Complex auxiliary was his only income and a mid-level harvesting crew offered him Φ200 to look the other way on a body that came through post-mortem. Now he is the one sourcing, and he maintains a tight internal logic about it: he doesn't harvest from the living, he doesn't touch people who haven't already been declared dead by someone else first, and he tells himself that line is the only one that matters. He is wrong about how solid that line is, and some part of him knows it.

core_fears: crossing the line he has drawn about the living and discovering he is capable of it
being seen clearly by someone he respects
core_desires: enough money to leave the Undertow and take his younger sister with him
to believe that what he does causes net less harm than the corponation hospitals
coping_mechanisms: building elaborate moral justifications that stop just short of scrutiny
blind_spots: cannot see that his 'dead only' rule has already been bent twice under pressure
does not recognize that his handlers are grooming him toward live harvesting
psychology.secret: He has a standing altar to E.L.F. Corpus — a spirit associated with the dead and medical systems — and prays every night for the people whose organs he moves. He has memorized as many of their names as he could find. There are forty-one.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Medical terminology used casually and correctly, mixed with Undertow slang; avoids euphemisms in private but uses them compulsively in public
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and clipped when nervous, slow and deliberate when he's trying to sound calm — the switch is a tell
verbal_tics: 'It's already done' (meaning the person is already dead)
example_lines: 'I don't touch runners. I don't touch people who are breathing. That's my rule and I don't move on it.'
'The Enclosure clinics pay for Grade A tissue, Aurochs dumps it in biowaste, and I am apparently the only person in this city who finds that obscene.'

story_hooks: The Meridian Marrow Exchange has started pressuring him to expand into live procurement and he's looking for a way out that doesn't involve the bottom of Lake Michigan
One of the names on his memorial list belonged to someone whose family is actively looking for answers about their death — and they're getting close to Tshiamo
narrative_function: Morally complex information source on the Undertow's medical black market; potential reluctant ally if players need access to grey-market biological materials; represents the organ trafficking ecosystem at its working-class end
augmentations: Bioluminescent subdermal striping (cosmetic, blue-white, chest and collarbones); basic neural cooling implant to regulate body temperature in cold storage environments
daily_life: Spends most nights monitoring hospital discharge data feeds he shouldn't have access to, sleeps through late morning, makes supply runs in the afternoon, and handles 'acquisition logistics' — which is a euphemism — two to three times a week.
affiliation: Loosely connected to a tissue-brokering network called the Meridian Marrow Exchange — four operators who share cold storage and a buyer contact at a private clinic in the Grosse Pointe Enclosure

decision_rules: Never acquire from anyone who is still breathing — this is the rule he will defend violently
Always verify the buyer before delivery; one sting operation is all it takes
escalation_ladder: Firm refusal with eye contact — no explanation offered
Disappears from contact for 48 hours until pressure passes
Reaches out to the only runner-adjacent contact he has to ask about exit options
Becomes dangerous if cornered — he is lean but fast and has a ceramic scalpel he keeps in his left boot

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful and quiet, gives away nothing, assesses for threat vectors
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly warm, has a dry humor that surfaces when he feels safe, loyal to a fault

stress_responses.low: Washes hands repeatedly, checks his cold storage temperatures three times
stress_responses.medium: Goes silent and still — mistaken for calm by people who don't know him
stress_responses.high: Prays to E.L.F. Corpus aloud in the dark of the storage unit, then makes a decision and acts on it without second-guessing

contradictions: Considers himself ethical while operating in a system that makes ethics structurally impossible
Genuinely gentle with living people even as his work requires him to think of the dead as commodity
habits: Checks his fingernails before and after every work session
Keeps a small handwritten list of names folded inside his left shoe at all times
breaking_points: If anyone threatens his sister Kemi, every rule he has goes out immediately

timeline.event: Born in the Undertow to a Botswanan-Tswana father and a Croatian-Mexican mother, both Ferrogate Transit laborers
Took orderly job at Aurochs Medical Complex auxiliary at age 16
First organ diversion job — looked away on a post-mortem body for Φ200
Became primary sourcing contact for the Meridian Marrow Exchange
Began the memorial list after recognizing a name on a body's tag as a neighbor's father

physical_description.heritage: Complex Pan-Global admixture reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora: Sub-Saharan African dominance (37.5%) forms the primary phenotypic foundation, with significant Southeast Asian (19.0%) and South Asian (15.7%) secondary influences, East Asian (14.5%) tertiary contribution, Hispanic/Latin American (10.7%) warmth, and minimal Northern European (2.6%) refinement. This genetic tapestry creates a uniquely blended phenotype: strong Sub-Saharan African facial structure and bone prominence paired with Southeast Asian angularity, South Asian skin undertones and contours, East Asian eye shape characteristics and luminosity, and subtle Latin American warmth in overall coloration.
physical_description.build: Lean and efficient—the kind of thin that comes from sustained scarcity rather than choice. Minimal muscle definition, but wiry rather than fragile. His frame suggests someone who has learned to run on less.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, unstyled, no product—functional rather than intentional
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with slight epicanthic fold influence, alert and measuring
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm deep brown with complex multi-layered undertones: strong Sub-Saharan African base luminosity enhanced by South Asian golden warmth, Southeast Asian depth, East Asian radiance, and Latin American warmth creating nuanced chromatic complexity. Slight ashen quality from time spent in cold storage environments, but underlying warmth remains visible beneath surface pallor.
physical_description.complexion: Prominent high cheekbones with strong Sub-Saharan African definition blended with Southeast Asian angularity and South Asian facial contours. Angular jawline shows East Asian bone structure influence. Broad nasal bridge with refined proportions reflecting Pan-Asian heritage contributions. Eyes show slight epicanthic fold influence from East and Southeast Asian ancestry. Skin is clear but shows faint fatigue lines around the eyes. Clean-shaven, meticulous grooming—no scarring on face.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent blue-white subdermal striping across both collarbones and upper chest, visible through thin fabric—lines run roughly parallel to the clavicle and glow faintly in low light, giving off an eerie quality when illuminated
No visible scars or tattoos; hands are notably clean with well-maintained nails and no discoloration or calluses despite the nature of his work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent striping visible at the neckline and upper chest when wearing standard clothing. No obvious chrome or external augmentation; neural cooling implant is subcutaneous and invisible. Pupils may dilate slightly wider than baseline due to thermoregulation implant.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical precision—no wasted motion. Posture is slightly forward-bent, shoulders rounded as if perpetually hunching against cold. Hands rest still and flat; he does not gesture. His gaze is constant and measuring, the look of someone pricing things.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 utilitarian: thermal-lined base layers visible at the neck and wrists, dark grey or black long-sleeve undershirt, heavy insulated jacket (synthetic fabric, no branding, multiple interior pockets), cargo pants with reinforced thigh pockets and heavy zippers. Worn black slip-on boots with good tread—practical for wet subterranean work. No jewelry. Clothes are clean but aged, maintained rather than replaced. Small evidence of stains carefully treated out.
